note: Village of Aylesbury campground on the edge of the village just off Hwy 11, 106 km north of Regina; treed sites with fire pits, plus group camping. Some highway road noise. --Claude
summary: Keep (thin). Village page confirms 8 electric + 18 non-electric sites, potable water, modern washroom/showers, C$40/night, booking by phone (306) 631-6745. Amperage, season, max length and the nightly share are not published; no Google listing; campground not located on imagery.
flags: PHONE: '' -> (306) 631-6745 (village page 'Booking Call: (306) 631-6745'; same number on the Tourism Saskatchewan listing). RV Life carries 306-734-2250 (an RM/village office-style number) - not used.
WEBSITE: both stored links answer 200 and describe this campground. No change.

BOOKING: stored reservable:false / fcfs:'always' were derived from the old note's 'self-registration'; the village now says 'Booking Call: (306) 631-6745', so reservable:true, platform phone. The stored fcfs 'always' stays in place (apply merges) but is unconfirmed - reviewer may clear it.

LONG-STAY: Tourism Saskatchewan calls it a 'Quiet campground and trailer park'. No split of nightly vs seasonal sites is published, and imagery does not show which block is the campground, so the nightly share is unmeasured. No Google Maps place exists for it (search falls through to Rowan's Ravine / the village). RV Life: 2 reviews (last 2022-07), rating 9.95/10, last reported rate 20.

PIN: unconfirmed. Stored 50.9383,-105.6895 sits by a building in the village's NE block, between the rail yard and residential lots; RV Life gives only the village point (50.9396,-105.6936). I could not identify campsites on Esri imagery (a treed block with a few trailers immediately SE of the pin is the likeliest spot). No move proposed.
HOOKUPS: amperage not published anywhere read; hookups not written.
